Clinical Overview

Understanding Orthopaedic Care

Bones, joints, muscles, ligaments, and tendons play an important role in how we move and carry out everyday activities. Pain, injury, or changes in these areas can affect your mobility and quality of life.

At Sanadi Orthopaedic Hospital, we provide personalised orthopaedic care based on your condition, symptoms, and recovery needs. Our approach begins with an accurate diagnosis and focuses on the right treatment for you, whether that involves medicines, physiotherapy, supportive care, or surgery when necessary.

From common joint problems and fractures to bone health concerns, our team helps you move toward better strength, mobility, and recovery.

KNOW WHEN TO SEEK CARE

When should you see an orthopaedic specialist?

You don't have to live with ongoing pain or difficulty moving. If you're experiencing any of these problems, it may be time to have your bones, joints, or muscles evaluated.

01

Ongoing Bone or Joint Pain

Pain that keeps coming back or gets worse while walking, working, exercising, or moving.

02

Difficulty Moving

Stiffness or reduced movement in your knee, hip, shoulder, back, or other joints.

03

Pain After an Injury

Pain, swelling, or difficulty using an arm or leg after a fall, accident, or sports injury.

04

Your Joint Feels Unstable

Your knee, ankle, shoulder, or other joint feels like it may give way, slip, or lock.

05

Changes in Strength or Movement

Increasing weakness, difficulty walking, changes in posture or trouble with everyday activities.

Clinical Expertise

Comprehensive Orthopaedic Care

Personalised care for common bone, joint, and injury-related conditions, with treatment based on your individual needs.

1 / FRACTURE MANAGEMENT

Fracture Treatment & Recovery

Care for broken bones and injuries, from initial assessment and stabilisation to treatment and follow-up.

  • Fracture Assessment & Stabilisation
  • Casts, Splints & Bracing
  • Surgical Fracture Treatment When Required
2 / JOINT PRESERVATION

Non-Surgical Joint Care

Treatment options designed to manage joint pain, improve movement, and support joint function while avoiding surgery when appropriate.

  • Joint Injections When Recommended
  • Bracing & Movement Support
  • Physiotherapy & Strengthening Exercises
3 / BONE DENSITY

Osteoporosis & Bone Health

Assessment and treatment to help identify bone weakness, reduce fracture risk, and maintain stronger bones.

  • Bone Density Assessment
  • Personalised Bone Health Treatment
  • Fall Prevention & Strengthening
Structured Protocol

Your Care Journey

A simple, step-by-step approach to help you understand your condition, treatment, and recovery.

01

Consultation

Your symptoms, medical history, and movement are carefully assessed by an orthopaedic specialist.

02

Diagnosis

Necessary imaging and diagnostic tests are recommended to understand the condition clearly.

03

Treatment Plan

Your doctor explains the recommended treatment options and helps you choose the approach best suited to your condition.

04

Treatment & Care

Your treatment is carried out with appropriate medical care, safety measures, and regular monitoring.

05

Rehabilitation

Physiotherapy and guided exercises help you regain movement, strength, and confidence during recovery.
